::: {.callout-note}
## Phase 0.75 is active

Phase 0.5 reading reconciliation is complete. Phase 0.75 is bounded to static upstream
audits, non-executing harness implementation, and protocol lock. No model, API,
prototype, benchmark, training, cloud, or paid-compute run is authorized.
:::

GIC Lab studies a narrower and more falsifiable question than “can we build a GIC agent?”:

> Which proposed mechanisms are necessary, sufficient, learnable, and measurably better than matched external orchestration?

The program begins with the authors' released SiRA and SR²AM references, then isolates one mechanism at a time under declared resource budgets. Negative and inconclusive evidence is a valid outcome.

## Phase 0.75 boundary

- Keep completed plans separate from the one authoritative active plan.
- Prepare source-grounded static audits of pinned SiRA and SR²AM revisions.
- Build an evidence-preserving harness whose execution defaults to unauthorized.
- Lock a draft first protocol without registering or running it during control-plane work.
- Preserve unresolved architecture questions for later architecture work without using
  them to block the first SiRA artifact execution.

See [project status](generated/status.qmd), the [claim map](research/claims.qmd), and the generated [experiment registry](generated/experiments.qmd).
